bullets.title: MRVL/LITE: $115B all-stock merger — Wolfe skeptical, deal risks elevated post-28% MRVL selloff
bullets.body: Marvell announced an all-stock acquisition of Lumentum at 4.5 MRVL shares per LITE share (~$115B EV), closing targeted 1H 2028. MRVL dropped ~28% post-announcement (LITE fell 35.9% week-over-week). Wolfe Research and UBS flagged ~38–62% deal termination risk given >20% acquirer price decline historically correlates with 62% total event rate; Jefferies sees compelling optical-silicon convergence logic but notes all-stock structure and China regulatory risk. Oppenheimer bull case: deal creates >$550B TAM with scale-up/scale-in NPO opportunity and >$1B annual cost synergies.

bullets.title: NET: Wolfe upgrades to Outperform ($340 PT); Citi reiterates Buy at $400 — best software print in years
bullets.body: Cloudflare reported Q3 revenue +39.2% YoY (best since 2022), ACV growth +38.5%, record customer adds, and NRR at 122%; Q4 guided ~37.5% growth. Wolfe upgraded to Outperform from Peer Perform, raising PT to $340 (25% upside) and FY26 revenue growth to 37%. Citi reaffirmed Buy/$400 citing record sales productivity and GAAP profitability pulled forward to Q4 2026 (prior target was 2028). Workers developer count doubled to 10M since March.

bullets.title: ABNB: Q3 blowout — nights +16% YoY, 4Q guided +16–18%; Citi upgrades to Buy at $193–$227 PT
bullets.body: Airbnb reported N&SB growth of +16% YoY accelerating vs. expectations of +12–13%, with Gross Bookings +21% and adj. EBITDA of $2.51B at 51.5% margin. Full-year 2026 revenue guidance raised to high-teens. Citi and multiple desks raised PTs: Citi to $193–$227 on AI-enhanced support and 1H27 agent launch catalyst. App N&SB grew +29% YoY. Stock gained ~15% week of Nov 6.

bullets.title: APP: +71% week-of-Nov-7 on Axon 3.0 beat — gaming +48% YoY, eCommerce +140% YoY; JPM $400 price target
bullets.body: AppLovin's Q3 delivered largest revenue beat in 6 quarters, with gaming up ~50% YoY and eCommerce growing triple digits YoY driven by Axon 3.0 model rollout. Q4 guidance seen as conservative. JPM highlighted APP as cheapest at mid-teens GAAP P/E on 2027 EPS; stock more than doubled from lows. Morgan Stanley estimated APP beat by 5%/6% revenue/EBITDA vs. their estimates.

bullets.title: DKNG: -28% on massive EBITDA guide cut — prediction market spend raises FY27 doubts
bullets.body: DraftKings cut FY26 adj. EBITDA guidance by ~65–72% (to ~$175–275M) and introduced FY27 guidance of $800M–$1B adj. EBITDA, ~20% below consensus, citing aggressive investment in prediction markets (~$650–700M in 2026 vs. prior $200–300M). Revenue beat but profitability collapse dominated. Citi raised concerns on ROI visibility; Morgan Stanley OW at $31 maintained but acknowledges investment step-up risks.

bullets.title: CHTR: 3Q pro-forma EBITDA -4% YoY; launches $2B cost reset — Wolfe Underperform, $117 PT
bullets.body: Charter Communications reported Q3 pro-forma revenue -2% and adj. EBITDA -4% YoY, with FCF of $674M badly missing estimates of $1.1–1.5B. Management announced a 'Hard Left' operating model with $2B annualized opex savings over 18 months plus $1B+ Cox synergies. Wolfe maintained Underperform ($117 PT), modeling only ~$1.1B realized in '27; stock down 43% YTD. Broadband ARPU facing -2pt headwind from reinvestment.

bullets.title: NVDA: Independent board investigation into CEO Jensen Huang foreign intelligence targeting; also at trough P/E ~13x
bullets.body: NVIDIA's board initiated an independent investigation after reports that CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort; board stated no evidence of security breach. Separately, multiple technicals notes flagged NVDA at ~13x forward P/E — 40% below its 10-year median trough of 22x — with one technical analyst (Roque) flagging downside risk to $100 on the weekly chart. Commerce Dept. cleared multiple Chinese firms to buy H200s despite sanctioned entity ties.

bullets.title: ORCL: Mizuho upgrades to Outperform ($320 PT) — funding overhang cleared, AI capacity constraints a tailwind
bullets.body: Mizuho upgraded Oracle to Outperform citing the AI selloff as a buying opportunity. ORCL completed a $20B financing ($10B debt, $10B equity) removing the major funding overhang. All five mega data-center sites are under construction with four permits secured; management incorporated potential 1-2 quarter delays. FY29–30 targets intact: $225B+ revenue, $21+ EPS, 40%+ non-GAAP operating margins. MSFT winding down older GPU rental deal was actually bullish — ORCL re-contracted at ~20% higher pricing.

bullets.title: AMD: Q3 beats; FY27 guided >80% revenue growth on data center — server CPU >100% YoY
bullets.body: AMD reported Q3 data center revenue of $8.55B (+97% YoY), 4Q guided $17B (vs. $16.3B consensus). Management guided FY27 revenue growth >80% with data center >80% of sales and AI GPU revenue more than doubling. Helios GPU ramping with Anthropic, Meta, Microsoft, Oracle, OpenAI. Goldman assigned Buy/$675 PT; Piper raised PT to $650. Supply constraint (not demand) is now the limiting factor.

bullets.title: ANET: Q3 +58% YoY; FY27 guided +38–40% — AI revenue to double to $7B, campus to $2B
bullets.body: Arista Networks beat Q3 by ~10%, with 2027 guidance of 38–40% revenue growth well above ~30% Street expectations. AI revenue expected to double to ~$7B in 2027; campus growing +60% to $2B. Morgan Stanley raised PT to $230, GS raised estimates. Scale-up trials in 2027 with revenue in 2028 provide further visibility. 100+ AI customers across 10+ accelerator types.

bullets.title: COHR: $20B 5-year NPO LTA; 45% gross margin target; FY27 revenue growth >60% — Citi raises PT to $440
bullets.body: Coherent reported FQ1 revenue of $2.37B beating estimates; Dec-Q guided $2.55–2.75B, ~$110M above consensus. Management secured ~$20B five-year long-term agreement with a major AI datacenter customer for NPO scale-up applications and raised long-term gross margin target to above 45% (from 42%) by end of CY2028. Citi raised PT from $420 to $440. Morgan Stanley Equal-Weight at $325 citing more modest valuation multiple.

bullets.title: TEAM: Cloud growth deceleration (-30.5% vs. expected 31.5%+) triggers -16-18% stock drop
bullets.body: Atlassian's F1Q27 showed the first cloud growth deceleration in five quarters to 30.5% (vs. guide of 28.5% beat, but below buyside expectations). Meek 50bp raises to FY27 subs ARR and cloud revenue growth implied material 2H deceleration. TEAM fell 13-18% post-earnings. Citi maintained Buy ($220 PT) citing AI/Collections upsell runway; Morgan Stanley maintained OW at $180.

bullets.title: LYV: Q3 massive beat — fans to approach 180M; Ticketmaster upgraded to high-single digit AOI growth
bullets.body: Live Nation reported Q3 revenue of $10.11B (+5% above consensus) with 61M fans (+19% YoY). Full-year fan attendance guidance raised to ~180M (from 175M). Ticketmaster AOI growth guidance upgraded from mid- to high-single-digit. Concerts on track for double-digit AOI growth. 2026 ticket sales up 13% to ~170M, already exceeding full-year 2025. Citi maintained Buy at $212 PT; Morgan Stanley OW at $215.

bullets.title: SHOP: Q3 GMV miss (-30% vs. 33%+ buyside) triggers -15-16% selloff; 4Q guide in-line
bullets.body: Shopify Q3 GMV grew +29.5% vs. buyside expectations of +33–34%, while revenue grew +32% and FCF beat. The 4Q revenue guide of 'low-30s%' was broadly in-line with consensus. Stock fell ~15-16% on positioning unwind and buyside disappointment. JPM maintained Overweight seeing the pullback as a buying opportunity; Mizuho maintained Outperform at $180. AI-driven orders on SHOP growing 3.3x vs. organic search with 64% higher conversion.

bullets.title: MU: Technically still 'massively overbought' per Roque; DRAM +12% M/M in October — Citi cuts supply/demand estimates
bullets.body: Micron remains in a technologically extreme overbought zone per technical analyst Roque, who targets the 300–540 range based on historical bear market drawdowns. Separately, Citi cut 2027 DRAM under-supply expectations to 3.8% (vs. prior 8.7%) and NAND to 3.3% on weaker consumer demand. KeyBanc maintained Overweight at $1,750 PT citing tight HBM supply and +12% M/M October DRAM contract pricing. TSMC is reportedly developing plans to manufacture 3D DRAM at NVIDIA's request.

bullets.title: W (Wayfair): Q3 beats — US revenue +11.4%, adj. EBITDA 30bps above; PT raised to $140; structural bull case intact
bullets.body: Wayfair delivered Q3 revenue +9.7% YoY (US +11.4%, best since 2021) with adj. EBITDA of $236M beating consensus by 5%. Active customers grew for a 3rd consecutive quarter. Mizuho and Citi both raised PT to $140 on improving advertising leverage and buyback introduction. Q4 guided 'at least high-single-digit%' top-line growth. AI-referred visits doubled sequentially to ~1% of traffic.

bullets.title: FWONK/TKO: GS raises PTs — Malone surrenders voting control; F1 FY27 growth intact
bullets.body: Goldman raised FWONK PT to $120 (from $116) after Q3 F1 revenue +28% YoY and hospitality/sponsorship beats; Malone sold high-vote Series B shares to Liberty reducing his voting stake to ~3%, simplifying capital structure. TKO PT raised to $218 on WWE partnerships +28% YoY and improving Middle East event visibility. Morgan Stanley maintains OW on FWONK at $125 and TKO at $230. SPHR PT cut to $150 on softer WoZ demand.

bullets.title: FOXA/ROKU: Fox completes Roku acquisition Nov 6; FOXA Q1 beat on record political/sports ad revenue
bullets.body: Fox Corp. completed the Roku acquisition at $160/share ($96 cash + 0.9693 FOX shares), valued at ~$22B EV. Concurrently, FOXA F1Q27 revenue of $4.57B beat consensus by 6% and adj. EBITDA of $1.64B beat by 22%, driven by World Cup, political ads (~$350M+ for the mid-term cycle), and Tubi growth (+35% YoY). UBS upgraded FOXA to Buy; Wolfe maintained Outperform at $93 PT (47% upside).

bullets.title: UBER: Citi initiates Buy at $105 PT — AV commercialization in 2027, 55M Uber One subscribers
bullets.body: Citi initiated coverage of Uber with a Buy rating and $105 PT citing AV commercialization transitioning from planning in 2026 to commercialization in 2027 (scaling in 2028+). 2,000+ AV supply targeted by end-2027; Uber One at 55M subscribers; Amazon/Uber Eats partnership expected to deliver incremental demand. Marketplace advantage: ~30% higher AV utilization vs. standalone operators.

bullets.title: Semis sector context: SOX -28% in 22 days — but trough P/E ~13x reached; tactical oversold signal
bullets.body: The SOX index fell ~28% over 22 days (one of largest rolling 1-month drawdowns in history), driven by election-related data center regulation fears, AI capex recalibration, and crowded unwind. By end of week, SOX traded at ~13x forward P/E (10-year median trough), Jefferies noted first time since April 2025 that SOXX and QQQ both sat in oversold territory. AI infrastructure names (CRWV, NBIS) fell 50-60%+ from highs on financing concerns.
